title: ClaimsExtractionOutput
description: Language-neutral schema for LLM claim extraction and verification output in Claim Ledger.

claims.description: List of individual checkable claims evaluated against the brand vault.

text.description: The exact or normalized checkable claim statement extracted from the draft.

verdict.description: Verification status: verified (fully supported by cited fact), conflicts (contradicted or scope ignored), unsupported (no approved source found), manual (ambiguous; human review needed).

factId.description: ID of the approved fact from the vault (e.g. F-001). Must be non-null for verified/conflicts, null for unsupported/manual unless citing related context.

excerpt.description: Exact text excerpt from the cited fact that grounds the verdict. Must appear in fact text if factId is provided.

explanation.description: Clear explanation of how the fact supports or conflicts with the claim, or note that no approved fact exists.

suggestedFix.description: Intent-preserving rewrite for conflicting claims, or null if verified/unsupported.
